title: Behavior used only by an env-gated spec needs a test that runs in CI
rule: When a Playwright describe is skipped without an env var (FM_SCREENS_DIR and the @screens spec), anything a criterion asks of it (a default, a route handler) is untested in CI. Add a test outside the skipped describe that uses the same constant and the same handler, and keep one implementation of the default rather than a copy in a script that no test can reach.
rationale: E40.2 (#444): the wall default and per-face fixture routing lived only in the skipped @screens describe and in a private copy in shots.mjs, so removing them left CI green.
